name: cfb-patient-favorites
why: Ten of thirteen sports agents are barren, while two library reports support college-football deep-favourite maker bids on reused development history. Test one controlled KXNCAAFGAME replication: resting YES bids at 93-97 cents, spread at most four cents, explicit resolution 6-36 hours away, managed order lifetime and no duplicate game exposure. The payout window excludes late entries but does not certify pregame status. Cap each entry at $2 including conservative fee reserves and the portfolio at $6 across three games, respecting cash, House limits and available event headroom. This is neither proven alpha nor a diagnosis of existing inactivity. Preserve applicable sports-favorites selection history; begin at rung 0 and require sufficient after-cost replay evidence, independent paper fills and settlements, audit and ordinary capital qualification. Reject inadequate samples rather than forcing turnover. Maker queue access and adverse selection remain unverified.
